methods.description: Evaluate inside absolute value signs, take the nonnegative distance from zero, then apply outside operations in order.
Find a number-line distance using the absolute value of the difference between the coordinates.
Use the stated basic product law and distinguish valid absolute value laws from invalid sum/subtraction rules; numerical comparisons use evaluation, not a general proof.
Use x for x≥0 and −x for x<0, including the zero boundary.
